params.body:
Reads the verdicts abovebeyond-ai/elixir#178 writes for `vitals`.

- Score, LCP, INP, CLS and Page weight take Elixir's word for their facet; the numbers next to them (50, 90, 3000) stay as fallback for a row written before Elixir judged, and go with the follow-up after the Monday round.
- The opportunity rows map the word Elixir wrote per row (`large`) and fall back to the 1000 ms only on an older row.
- One `Judged` line names the thresholds that fired.

Behaviour on current rows unchanged. Two tests in a new `VitalsCardTest`. Suite green except the worktree-only `BuildStampTest`; PHPStan and Pint clean. Either merge order works.
params.title: The Core Web Vitals card reads Elixir's verdict per facet
